reading.body:
EdgeConneX CHI01 in Elk Grove Village publishes 24 MW of critical IT power and is reported by the operator as fully occupied. At a typical AI training density of 40 kW per rack, this would correspond to roughly 600 racks, though the operator has not published capacity in those terms. The facility holds ENERGY STAR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2 Type 2, and ISO 27001 certifications, qualifying it to host regulated workloads and systems subject to healthcare and payment security requirements.

Within Illinois, this campus ranks seventh by published capacity among 44 mapped facilities in the state, accounting for roughly 10 percent of the 236 MW of published data center IT load currently documented here. Only six facilities in the state publish power figures at all, making CHI01 part of a small set of disclosed assets.

The site sits 6 miles from O'Hare International Airport and 25 miles from downtown Chicago. Whether this campus matters to AI scaling depends on factors not published by the operator: the availability of grid power for expansion, the cost and timing of that power, and the actual tenant mix now occupying the reported full capacity.
